name: program-runtime.improvement-evidence
purpose: Compose revision-aware attention candidates and explicit Agent Manager run evidence for an authorized program or scenario repair; return child validity and artifact identities without inference or mutation.

run_ids.description: One to eight explicit evidence run IDs; caller owns relevance to the campaign.

limit.description: 1..5 candidates; preview does not reserve work.

assumptions: Caller has selected an authorized campaign and relevant run evidence.
Child programs are available in the session library.
invariants: Exactly two bounded child program calls after validation; no launches, inference, claims, or subject mutations.
Partial, refused, unavailable, malformed and failed child evidence is never promoted to success.
The caller must claim work before parallel repair and validate independently before recording review credit.
Exactly one envelope at most 65536 bytes; child artifacts remain identified.

signals.children: Two child envelopes with explicit status, signals and failures.
signals.mutation_authorized: Always false; evidence confers no authority.

outputs.evidence: Child program names and bounded artifact identity. Child errors retain their owner vocabulary.
